mechanism: Amphetamine-induced sympathomimetic effects may increase cardiovascular stress and hyperglycemia risk, while dapagliflozin increases euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis risk; amphetamine may also cause dehydration exacerbating SGLT2 inhibitor-related volume depletion.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely, assess cardiovascular status, ensure adequate hydration, and consider alternative stimulant therapy if possible in patients requiring dapagliflozin.
